en: Come on, why are you nervous?

How can I not be!? Whether you win or lose here is huge for
all of us!
It could be the big break our agency needs!
That's true. I'll do my best.

Sorry, didn't mean to put pressure on ya. But, seriously,
with all the effort ya put in, I know you'll do just fine.

And remember, it's the total score you're going for, so
don't sweat it if you lose a round. You can make up for it
in the others.
Okay... Yeah, that helps take some of the pressure off.

Good. Just try to stay relaxed. Can't do your best if you're
too nervous.

Well, not much time before it starts. If you wanna prepare,
now's the time to do it.

Ogita-san's in the studio on the fourth floor. I'm sure he'd
give you a lesson now if you want.

When you're ready, come check the schedule board like ya did
before.
Okay, I will.
Good morning!

Morning, Haruka-chan. You sound happy. Something good
happen?
A little, yeah.
Glad to hear it. Well, let's give it our best today.

Let's get right to it. We'll start off with today's
schedule.
Mind takin' a look at that schedule board?

(Okay. I'm done changing. I'll just say goodbye to Horie-san
before going home.)
Hmm. That wasn't half bad. You're really comin' along.
All right. That's enough for today.

But it's gonna be another hard day tomorrow, so don't think
about stayin' out late or anythin' like that. You gotta get plenty of rest.
Good work.
The Princess League finals start tomorrow.
If you win, we'll be putting a major marketing push behind you.

In preparation for that, I've arranged the ultimate
opportunity.
Ultimate?

Four days after the final round of the Princess League
finals...
You'll make your debut at a live concert in Tokyo.
A concert in Tokyo!?
That's right. It'll be your time to shine.

You'll be the talk of the town, and the buzz will only build
from there.

Going to Tokyo will be proof that you've made it to the big
leagues. Do you understand?
In other words, there's no room for failure.
Hm? Why the long face? That's not like you.
It's just that... it's a lot to take in all at once.

Don't be silly. This is only the beginning. It's going to be a
whirlwind from here on, the likes of which you never even imagined.

Hundreds of thousands of people across the country will be
listening to your songs. Millions of people will take notice of you.

What others call unreal will be just another day in the life
to you. You need to be ready.
But we still don't know if I'll win or not...
True, but I believe you won't lose.
If you lose, I'll stop supporting the orphanage in Okinawa.

I imagine it will have to shut down, and you won't have a
home to return to...
You understand, don't you, Haruka?
I do. No matter what happens, I'll never give up!

Good. Well, you must be tired... I just thought I'd give you
a little pep talk.
Oh, and one thing you should remember...

The goal of a pop idol is to be loved by as many people as
possible. Right?

And the people who love you, your fans, will express their
love in a wide variety of words and ways.
You have to learn how to accept them⑬all of them.

I doubt there're many women out there who mind being told
that they're loved or beautiful...

Whenever a person first becomes famous, they're usually
thrilled by all of the attention and adoration.

But then one day they realize that the love from their fans
isn't real love.

Love from fans is a one-sided thing. Though we call it
"love," it's really something quite different.

And when this reality hits, most idols tend to crash and
burn.

You would think that they could come to terms with it, and
just keep moving forward...
But, the truth is, they just can't.

Because these girls believe that to be loved is simply their
right, a fact of life.

They've had their parents at their side, gone to school⑬a
completely normal upbringing. They take the love of their
friends and family for granted.

The love these girls come to expect from being raised in
said normal environment has made them weak.
They can't tell the difference between one-sided love and real love.

So once they realize the love from fans isn't real, they're
devastated. They feel like all love is lost to them forever.

People who take love for granted aren't able to properly
distinguish its different forms.
Its different forms...

Now, you've chosen to walk this road, and I understand you
may feel a little daunted right now.
But there's one thing about you I know for certain.

You're a girl who already knows very well what it means to
be loved.
You will be just fine. You can do this.
Have confidence in yourself.
...Were you raised in an environment similar to mine?

Well, aren't you the perceptive one? Yes, I, too, was raised
without the love of my biological parents.
I was severely abused by them before I could even walk or talk.

For a long time, I lived without being loved by anyone... It
was then I saw pop idols on TV. How attractive it all was.

These girls were loved by so many people, something I could
never relate to. I was dazzled by them.

So, as a child, I made the decision to become an idol
myself. Of course, I never managed to make it big.

Tomorrow begins with a fan club sponsored event. Then in the
afternoon, it's round one of the Princess League finals on
Soten TV.

Come to the office at nine tomorrow morning. Oh, and by the
way, I'm assigning Horie to be your manager, starting tomorrow.
Now go home and get some rest.
Yes, ma'am... Have a good night.
You, too.
Park-san... I'm going to give this everything I have.
Of course you are. I know that.
Ready to continue your lesson?

Listen, Haruka. I'm sure I don't have to tell ya, but you
gotta keep going till you know this like the back of your
hand.

The lesson's not done until you master my moves right
through to the end of the song. Got it?
Ready to start your lesson now?
Good. Here we go.
Hey, see what happens when you try?

All right. You can have a five minute break, then it's back
to work.
Right. Thank you.
You got 400 experience points.
Okay, once more from the top.
This is basic stuff here, you know.

If you can't do this, then I'm just wasting my time. Now,
focus!

(I have lessons in the morning. Maybe I should get some
sleep.)
(Maybe I'll go for a walk.)
(I have a busy day tomorrow. I should get to bed.)
I promise I'll work really hard today!
(Maybe I should get some sleep.)
(Maybe I'll go for a walk to clear my head.)
(I'll need to get plenty of sleep for tomorrow.)
(A package arrived.)
(Looks like I got a package.)
(Got a package delivered.)
(Hey, I got a package!)
You received a package from an online shop.
Good job, Haruka-chan. Were you nervous?
Yes, I'm sorry. I was getting pretty flustered!

That's all right. You'd never done anythin' like this
before, and it was all so sudden, too.
Anyway, let's go see Manda-san again.
Fantastic job, Haruka-chan!
I was a little nervous.
Well, it didn't show. You really stood out!
Ah, the people from Dyna Chair...
We're terribly sorry about earlier today!
Our sincerest apologies!
Wait. Hold it right there.
Good timing, you two! This is perfect.

Well, we had that famous model⑬I can't seem to remember her
name⑬scheduled to go on our game show, but she up and
canceled last minute!

The studio's in an uproar! But here you people come along
like a gift from up above! What do you say? Think you can
take her place, young lady?

Wha...? Yes, of course! Haruka's schedule is open for the
rest of the day.

Whaddya think, Haruka-chan? Can you do it? He said it's some
sort of game show...
Yes, of course! I'd love to go on!
Great! That's the spirit!
Hey, Hayashida! I found a fill-in!

A fill-in...? Wait! You're Haruka Sawamura! Wow! Aren't we
lucky! All right, let me explain how it's going to go. Right
this way, if you would.
I don't know. I'm really bad at that kind of thing...

Don't worry about a thing! You'll do great! Hey, Hayashida!
I found a fill-in!
Really? Okay...
Er... Good luck!
Okay, let's find Manda-san.
You did it, Haruka-chan! That was great!

Truly amazing performance! Keep it up, and I'll bet you'll
win round two tomorrow, too!
Really? I hope so!
What a shame. I'm so sorry, Haruka-chan...

But don't worry. You did great out there! I bet ya can win
round two tomorrow!
I'm sorry. I'll do better tomorrow!
I'm sure you're upset, but T-Set is some pretty stiff competition.
They aren't like any of the others you've gone up against.
Just try to shake it off and regroup for round two tomorrow!
All right, I will!
Okay, let's head back to Sotenbori.
We really should apologize to Manda-san again...

But he's not answering his cell. I hope he ain't still
mad...
Me, too.
Hmm. Not bad, not bad.
Wow! I've never looked this good before!
Heh, see what happens when you're in the hands of a professional? Oh, by the way, bumpkin, I have a little present for you.
A quick-change costume. It's an old, special design of mine, and I just can't bear to see it go to waste, so I want you to have it.

Quick-change is all about timing, my dear. When you feel the
time is just right, change into this and watch everyone be
blown away!
Oh, my goodness! Thank you so very much!
And now the rest is up to you, my little bumpkin.

Thank you again, Yoko-san! But... why are you being so nice
to me?

Well... you remind me of someone. A certain idol I used to
work on.

But, in the end, I wasn't able to make her shine like she
deserved...

I see this as my second chance, part of my own little
agenda, you might say.
If that bothers you, feel free to say so.
Bother me? Of course not!  I'm very grateful to you.
Good. Well then, I think I'll get going.

You can find me under Iwao Bridge in Sotenbori if you ever
want to learn more beauty secrets. Good luck, now!
Thank you very much, Yoko-san!

There are many advantages to Yoko's training.

 -It fills the Climax Heat Gauge.
 -It boosts the number of times Idol Heat can be used.
 -It greatly improves Appeal.

Train with Yoko before a Princess League round to prepare
yourself for victory!
Hey, are you all ready?
Okay, I'm comin' in.
What do you think? Do I look strange?
Actually, I'd say you look fantastic!

Oh, I'm so glad! I don't have much experience with makeup
and all.

Why, the way you look, even T-Set's fans'll be fallin' in
love with you!
Okay, I guess it's time.

And don't worry. Just do what you've been practicin' in your
lessons, and you'll be just fine.
You've put a ton of effort into this! So have confidence in yourself.
Come in!
Excuse me. Sawamura-san, are you ready?
We've had some bad blood with Osaka Talent.
Did ya know T-Set used to go to our trainin' school?

But they just couldn't deal with the way Park-san does
things, so they moved to Osaka Talent.
I didn't know that.

I'd try not to agitate them too much if I were you... But no
worries if ya do.

I guess you gotta be tough if you wanna make it in this
business.
Agitate?

Huh? Isn't that what you were tryna to do by telling 'em to
shove off to Okinawa?
They just seemed stressed, that's all.
Okinawa really is a wonderful place.

If you ever get the chance, you should go see it for
yourself someday. Watch all your worries disappear.
I see. Guess you're a girl of a much higher caliber than I realized.

Well, anyway, we kinda got off to a bad start before the
performance even started, but let's try and pull it together. You can do this!
Your clothes are all ready to go, so go ahead and get changed.
You can use the makeup that's here.
I'll be waiting outside. Okay, good luck!
I'm coming in!
Yoko-san!?
But isn't Horie-san...? Didn't you see my manager outside?
Oh, him? Yes, I saw a fellow with a very serious face out there. He must've been lost in thought.
Oh, okay... Anyway, what brings you here?

What brings me here? Hmm. Maybe it has something to do with
the fact that you're a little country bumpkin?
A bumpkin!? What do you mean!?

A rugged little bumpkin fresh off the farm. You can't even
stay on your feet, it seems.
Oh... You saw that?

I just happened to, yes. So those two are your opponents, is
that right?

Well, setting aside their obvious lack of manners, they
certainly look professional.

I don't know anything about your level of talent, but right
now you're clearly at a disadvantage.
That may be true, but what else can I do but do my best?

Listen up, little bumpkin. I'm sorry if this stings a bit,
but simply doing your best won't earn you any recognition in
this industry.
